home.testerHeading: Try the apps before anyone else
home.testerBody: If you want to help me test an app before launch, joining takes two minutes and you can leave whenever you like.

app.notYet: Not available yet. News coming soon.
app.testerIntro: Try {name} before launch and help me find problems.

tester.heading: Become a tester
tester.intro: charDev apps go through a closed test on Google Play before launch. Joining takes two minutes and you can leave whenever you like.

join.step1: Join the Google testers group (one click).
join.step2: Open the app's test link and tap “Become a tester”.
join.step3: Install the app from Google Play with the same Google account.

leave.step1: Open the app's test link again and tap “Leave the program”.
leave.step2: Uninstall the test version. If you like, install the public version from Google Play afterwards.
leave.step3: If you don't want to take part in any other test, leave the testers group.

tester.groupNote: The testers group is the same for every app: if you leave the group, you stop receiving tests for all of them.
tester.noneTesting: No app is open to testers right now. Check back soon.

faq.q1: What data does charDev keep about me?
faq.a1: None: this site has no forms or accounts. Google manages the tester list through the group.
faq.q2: How do I report a problem?
faq.a2: Write to {email} and tell me what you did and which phone model you use.
faq.a3: For now, tests are Android only, through Google Play.

suguruneon.tagline: Neon logic puzzles. Fully offline, no sign-up.
suguruneon.description: Suguru with a neon look: fill each region with numbers so none repeat between neighboring cells. It has hints, a daily challenge, and several themes. Works offline with no sign-up.

aquimascotas.tagline: Responsible adoption and lost-pet search, with your local community.
aquimascotas.description: AquiMascotas connects pets with responsible families and helps reunite lost pets with their owners. It offers responsible adoption, lost-pet search, and a local community.

geli.tagline: Save links from any app and organize them into collections. No accounts.
geli.description: GeLi saves the links you share from any app and organizes them into collections. With search, a detail view, dark mode, and no accounts.

reinaneon.description: Place one queen per row, column, and region so none touch. A sister app to SuguruNeon, with hints, a daily challenge, and several themes.
